chunks: 2253 - The pilgrim is of three categories. The best of them in share is a man for whom what has preceded of his sin and what comes later is forgiven, and Allah protects him from the punishment of the grave. As for the one after him, he is a man whose sin that had preceded is forgiven for him, and he resumes deeds in what remains of his life. As for the one after him, he is a man who is protected regarding his family and his wealth.
And it has been narrated: “That he is the one from whom the hajj is not accepted.”
ai.seo_question: What are the three categories of pilgrims in this hadith, and which one receives the greatest reward?
ai.summary: This hadith describes three ranks of those who perform hajj, differing in the extent of divine forgiveness and protection they receive. The highest rank receives complete forgiveness and safety from the punishment of the grave, while another report indicates that the lowest category may refer to one whose hajj is not accepted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2253 - The pilgrim falls into three categories:
The one with the greatest reward is a person whose past and his future sins are forgiven, and Allah (swt) protects them from the punishment of the grave.
The next is a person whose past sins are forgiven, and they start anew in their remaining life with fresh deeds.
The third is a person who is protected in their family and wealth.
It has also been narrated: "This last category refers to the one whose Hajj is not accepted."
